step_1_identify_effect.claim: The only cached item effect that produces a 1.12 damage multiplier attributable to 'Abyssal Mask — Unmake' is Abyssal Mask (id 8020) passive 'Unmake'.
step_1_identify_effect.quoted_wiki_text: Enemy champions within {{tt|700 units|center to edge}} of you become cursed, causing them to receive {{as|12% increased magic damage|magic damage}} from all sources.
step_1_identify_effect.source_file: data/items.json -> "8020".passives[0].branches[0] (read via the branches list, per CLAUDE.md rule 6)

step_2_magnitude.derivation: '12% increased magic damage' is an increased-damage-taken amplifier, so the multiplier is 1 + 12/100 = 1.12.
corroboration: data/items.json -> "8020".riotDescription: 'Nearby enemy champions take 12% more <magicDamage>magic damage</magicDamage>.'

data/atoms/items.json -> "8020" atom 'damage.magic' (behavior 'damage', source 'Abyssal Mask.passives[0].branches[0]', values [700.0, 12.0], units ['flat','percent'], evidence 'passive:Unmake@kw:magic damage')
data/atoms/items.json -> "8020" atom 'control.curse' (same values [700.0, 12.0]) — the 700 is the aura radius, the 12 is the percent
step_2_magnitude.result: 1.12 is the exactly correct magnitude on the pinned data (patch 16.15, data/staleness.json checked_at 2026-08-06). staleness.json marks 8020 stale=false with empty stat_drift, so the cache is current — no patch-drift explanation for a value change.

step_3_gates_the_wiki_text_imposes.damage_type: MAGIC ONLY. The text says '12% increased magic damage'. Physical and true damage events receive NO Unmake amplification. (Contrast Imperial Mandate below, which is type-agnostic.)
step_3_gates_the_wiki_text_imposes.target_type: ENEMY CHAMPIONS only ('Enemy champions ... become cursed'). Minions/monsters/structures are not cursed.
step_3_gates_the_wiki_text_imposes.geometry: Within 700 units (center to edge) of the Abyssal Mask HOLDER — not of the attacker.
step_3_gates_the_wiki_text_imposes.attribution: 'from all sources' — so an ALLY holding Abyssal Mask legitimately amplifies the main attacker's magic damage. Modeling this as a roster/ally-carried 'support_damage_multiplier' is semantically correct.

step_4_availability_check.why: CLAUDE.md rule 6 — an item whose sources are missing must be withheld; that would be one legitimate way for the leaf to vanish. Checked and rejected.
step_4_availability_check.conclusion: Abyssal Mask is an ordinary, unrestricted, purchasable Summoner's Rift item tagged SUPPORT. No availability rule withholds it from a roster support build, so 'item not available' cannot justify the removal.

step_5_the_other_named_item.quoted_wiki_text: {{tip|Immobilize|Immobilizing}} an enemy champion marks them as ''Vulnerable'' for 4 seconds, increasing the damage they take from all sources by 7%. Subsequent immobilizes against a target extend the duration of the effect.
step_5_the_other_named_item.why_it_matters: Vulnerable is a 7% amp on ALL damage types, gated on an immobilize within the last 4 s. If it were co-active at event 12 the correct combined support amplifier would be 1.12 x 1.07 = 1.1984 (multiplicative composition, the convention docs/math-foundations.md uses for stacked multipliers) or 1.19 if composed additively — neither of which is either candidate value.
step_5_the_other_named_item.why_not_selected: The old leaf carries a single source string naming only Abyssal Mask, which is consistent with Vulnerable being inactive at event 12 (its 4 s window elapsed, or no ally immobilize is assertable in the model). Nothing in data/ lets me assert an immobilize at event 12, so I do not charge the missing 7% against either candidate.

step_6_no_stacking_or_group_exclusion.checked: data/economics-sourced.json -> groups_26_12 (the item-group / named-item-effect exclusivity table)
step_6_no_stacking_or_group_exclusion.finding: There is no group containing 'Unmake' or Abyssal Mask (groups present: Annul, Blight, Boots, Dirk, Elixir, Eternity, Fatality, Glory, Guardian, Hydra, Immolate, Lifeline, Manaflow, Momentum, Potion, Quicksilver, Soul Anchor, Spellblade, Starter, Stasis, Trinket). Abyssal Mask's curse is therefore not suppressed by any named-item-effect exclusivity with another item in the build.

step_7_docs_check.finding: No formula, audit-table row, or prose in math-foundations.md governs support/aura damage amplifiers (grep for abyssal|unmake|mandate|vulnerab|support_damage|aura|curse|amplif returns only two unrelated hits in the penetration section, lines 292 and 328). The document therefore neither authorizes nor forbids the removal; the whole burden rests on the cached wiki text above.

independent_computation.conclusion: The correct value for a MAGIC-damage event dealt to an enemy champion standing within 700 units of the roster ally who holds Abyssal Mask is exactly multiplier = 1.12, attributed to 'Abyssal Mask — Unmake'. Absence is correct ONLY if event 12 fails one of the three gates in step 3 (non-magic damage, non-champion target, or holder out of range). None of those conditions is derivable from data/ — and the two I can test from cached data (the item is available; the effect is not group-suppressed) both come back in favor of the amplifier applying.

sources_quoted.text: Enemy champions within {{tt|700 units|center to edge}} of you become cursed, causing them to receive {{as|12% increased magic damage|magic damage}} from all sources.

Immobilizing an enemy champion marks them as ''Vulnerable'' for 4 seconds, increasing the damage they take from all sources by 7%. Subsequent immobilizes against a target extend the duration of the effect.
patch 16.15, checked_at 2026-08-06T12:36:09Z; "8020" Abyssal Mask stale=false, stat_drift {}, note ""
no item group contains Abyssal Mask or 'Unmake' (checked all 21 groups)
no rule governing support/aura damage amplifiers; formula-audit table §5 has no row for damage-taken amplifiers

verdict_reasoning: 1.12 with source 'Abyssal Mask — Unmake' reproduces the cached wiki text exactly (1 + 12/100), the aura is explicitly 'from all sources' so an ally-carried curse legitimately amplifies the attacker's magic damage, the item passes every availability gate the repo's own rule 6 imposes, the data is not stale, and no group-exclusivity suppresses the effect. I could find no rule in data/ or docs/math-foundations.md that removes the multiplier. Absence is defensible only under an event-local condition — event 12 dealing physical or true damage (Unmake is magic-only), targeting a non-champion, or the holder being outside 700 units — and none of those is observable from the permitted evidence.

residual_uncertainty_and_falsifier.statement: The permitted evidence tree contains no definition of scenario 'mandate_abyssal_curse_roster' (checked data/practice-corpus/scenarios.json, which holds 22 unrelated scenarios, plus data/worklists/, data/champion-audit/, data/atoms/, data/wiki/). I therefore cannot observe the damage type of events[12].
residual_uncertainty_and_falsifier.falsifier: If events[12] is a PHYSICAL or TRUE damage event (e.g. an auto attack or an on-hit proc in the rotation), then Unmake's magic-only gate makes the amplifier inapplicable and the new <absent> is correct — flip this verdict to new_value_correct. The change should be asked to state event 12's damage type and target.
residual_uncertainty_and_falsifier.second_falsifier: If Imperial Mandate's Vulnerable is co-active at event 12 (an immobilize within the preceding 4 s) on a magic-damage event, then the correct combined value is 1.12 x 1.07 = 1.1984 and BOTH candidates are wrong (both_wrong).
